apps/web/src/components/workspace/Accent.description: Custom color picker for workspace branding. Uses a curated 12-color palette or raw hex input.

apps/web/src/components/workspace/Create.description: Onboarding modal for creating a new workspace. Collects name, description, and accent color.

apps/web/src/components/workspace/Worksp.description: Image upload component for workspace logos. Supports PNG/JPEG/WebP with client-side size validation.
Persistent vertical navigation for workspace switching. Always visible in the dashboard layout.

apps/web/src/hooks/useCapability.js.description: Core hook for RBAC checks in components. Reactively determines if the current user can perform an action based on their role in the active workspace.

apps/web/src/lib/api.js.description: Centralized API client. Wraps fetch with automatic 401 interceptors for JWT silent refresh and JSON/FormData handling.

apps/web/src/lib/realtimeBridge.js.description: Client-side orchestrator for Socket.io events. Connects backend broadcast events to specific Zustand store mutations (upsert/patch/remove).

apps/web/src/stores/actionItemsStore.js.description: State management for tasks. Implements optimistic UI for drag-and-drop movements and status bucket sorting.

apps/web/src/stores/analyticsStore.js.description: State management for workspace statistics and activity charts.

apps/web/src/stores/announcementsStore.j.description: State management for announcements. Handles pinning logic, sorting by recency/pin status, and real-time updates.

apps/web/src/stores/authStore.js.description: Global authentication state. Manages the current user object, login/register flows, and profile updates.

apps/web/src/stores/commentsStore.js.description: State management for announcement comment threads. Maps comments to announcement IDs.

apps/web/src/stores/goalsStore.js.description: State management for high-level goals. Coordinates fetching, status changes, and deep goal views.

apps/web/src/stores/milestonesStore.js.description: State management for goal milestones. Handles per-goal milestone list hydration and progress updates.

apps/web/src/stores/notificationsStore.j.description: State management for user notifications. Tracks unread counts and handles real-time delivery of new items.

apps/web/src/stores/presenceStore.js.description: State management for real-time user presence. Maintains a Set of online user IDs in the active workspace.

apps/web/src/stores/reactionsStore.js.description: State management for emoji reactions. Implements optimistic toggling with server-side reconciliation.

apps/web/src/stores/themeStore.js.description: User preference for UI theme (light/dark/system). Persists choice to localStorage and applies classes to document element.

apps/web/src/stores/workspaceMembersStor.description: State management for workspace membership and invitations. Handles role updates, removal, and invitation lifecycle.

apps/web/src/stores/workspaceStore.js.description: Global workspace list and active selection state. Persists the last active workspace ID for seamless return on login.

apps/web/src/stores/auditStore.js.description: State management for workspace audit logs. Supports pagination and server-side filtering by type or actor.

packages/shared/src/index.js.description: Universal source of truth for constants and logic. Defines the CAPABILITIES/ROLES schema, socket event names, and RBAC utility functions.
